attributes.board_name: Texas Physician Assistant Board (Texas Medical Board)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 hours formal Category I from a CME sponsor approved by the American Academy of Physician Assistants (AAPA); up to 20 informal Category II hours (self-study, hospital lectures, grand rounds, case conferences)
rules.alternatives: Presumed compliant with the formal and informal hours if meeting NCCPA certification maintenance requirements; NCCPA does not cover the human trafficking and opioid requirements.
rules.new_licensee_rule: If the initial registration cycle is less than 24 months, no CE is required before the first renewal.
rules.carryover: Up to 80 excess hours (40 per category) may be carried forward for up to two years; the human trafficking course must be completed before each renewal.
rules.audit_note: Mandatory CE tracking via CE Broker for all TMB licensees from September 1, 2026; certificates go to CE Broker, not with the registration.

topics.who: PAs with a prescriptive authority agreement authorizing opioid prescribing or with PMP access; pain management and opioid prescribing, within 1 year of issuance and then every renewal
PAs who provide direct patient care; HHSC-approved course before each renewal
PAs treating patients in an emergency room/urgent care setting; SASTF-approved course; starts with licenses expiring Feb 28, 2027 (HB 47)

rules.notes: Also 1 hour nutrition and metabolic health for all PAs (Occ. Code 204.1563), licenses expiring on/after May 30, 2027. The 24-month period runs from expiration date to expiration date of the biennial registration.
rules.rule_quote: Physician assistants need to complete at least 40 credits of continuing medical education every 24 months.
